nm EXPOSURES (evidenced, share exposed): (1) Taiwan supply: 100% of wafers from TSMC in FY2026 (10-K Item 1 'exclusively used TSMC'); assembly/test contractors principally in Taiwan; 67% of PP&E in Taiwan; the 10-K names PRC-Taiwan tension as a risk to 'a substantial amount of our revenue'. (2) China/Hong Kong: ship-to mainland China fell to 0.2% of Q1 FY2027 revenue (6.1% FY2026, 18.3% FY2025) and Hong Kong is 19.0% (Q1 FY2027) / 28.3% (FY2026); R&D and staff in mainland China and Hong Kong; PRC blocking rules (MOFCOM Order No. 1, State Council Order No. 835 of April 2026) could conflict with US export controls (10-K risk factors). (3) Export controls: the 10-K states the company sells into Asian markets where customers face US export restrictions and that it 'ha[s] in the past and may again in the future determine that certain exports may have been made in violation of Trade Controls laws' (remediation described, no amount stated): a compliance flag for the counter-thesis. (4) Tariffs: risk factor on US tariffs on semiconductor products and PRC trade tensions, no quantified cost. (5) Customer concentration (10-K Note 3 / 10-Q Note 3): Customer A 49% and Customer B 32% of FY2026 revenue (top 10 ~90%); Q1 FY2027 A 43%, B 28%; receivables A 57%, B 28% on 2026-08-01. Customers are unnamed (gather_documents owns names). (6) Tax: effective tax about 0.7% in FY2026 (Cayman parent); OECD Pillar Two named as a risk.

nm ROIC CHECK prefetch/forensic.json roic is 'unavailable' (it needs operating income, equity, debt and cash per year), so it was computed here from the filing figures (derived, not engine output). Invested capital = equity - cash - short-term investments (no financial debt; operating leases of 25.4M FY2026 / 26.2M Q1 FY2027 not added; adding them lowers ROIC by about 1-2 points). FY2026: invested capital 620.3M (equity 2,063.6M less cash and short-term investments 1,443.3M); NOPAT at a notional 21% tax = 445.0M x 0.79 = 351.6M, ROIC 56.7%; at the reported effective rate of 0.7% (tax 3.2M on 475.4M pre-tax) NOPAT 442.1M and ROIC 71.3%; if short-term investments are treated as operating (equity + leases - cash only, the Alpha Vantage balance-sheet view) invested capital is 924.1M and ROIC 38-48%. Incremental ROIC FY2025 to FY2026 (notional 21% tax): change in NOPAT 322.2M on change in invested capital 370.1M = 87%. After the DustPhotonics deal (Q1 FY2027): invested capital 1,964.2M (equity 2,728.5M less cash and short-term investments 764.3M); trailing-twelve-month operating income 505.0M (FY2026 445.0M - Q1 FY2026 60.7M + Q1 FY2027 120.7M), NOPAT at 21% 398.9M, ROIC 20.3% (25.5% at the effective rate; 38.8% on the average of FY2026 and Q1 FY2027 capital in the second case). Excluding goodwill (986.4M) and acquired intangibles (378.8M) invested capital is 599.0M and ROIC 66.6%. Reading: the high ROIC before the deal came from a business that needed little capital and a big cash pile that is excluded; the acquisition moved 1.25B into goodwill, intangibles and contingent consideration, so the return on the capital now deployed is far lower until DustPhotonics earns; the tax rate of about 0% flatters GAAP net income and the 21% case is the conservative one.
